features: modular AutoDome system: interchangeable CPU / camera / housing / comms / mount modules
day/night PTZ camera choice: 18x, 26x, or 36x optical zoom (+12x digital)
36x variant: 3.4-122.4 mm F1.6-4.5, 540 TVL, 128x wide dynamic range
AutoTrack II automated motion tracking + video motion detection + image stabilization
advanced alarm control with rules engine; privacy masking and sector blanking
continuous 360-degree pan, 360 deg/s preset pan speed
hybrid analog (coax/UTP, Bilinx, cable compensation) + optional Ethernet H.264 IP streaming
EnviroDome housing to -40 C; IP66 pendant / IK8 in-ceiling
release_notes: The Bosch AutoDome 500i Series is the intelligent tier of the VG4 modular analog PTZ dome system, offered with 18x/26x/36x day/night cameras (1/4-inch Exview HAD CCD, 540 TVL, 128x WDR) and adding AutoTrack II tracking, video motion detection, image stabilization, and a rules-based alarm engine over the 300 Series. Hybrid analog (coax/UTP, Bilinx) with an optional Ethernet module for H.264 IP streaming; no IR illuminator. EnviroDome housing rated to -40 C.
